description: Optimized curved conformal 2.4 GHz patch (issue #1087): base and moved coordinates of the substrate-top surface nodes (the patch nodes among them, is_patch) with the patch and substrate-top triangles, bent frame. The ground plane is not dumped: it does not move radially, and its mesh nodes slide only tangentially under outline DOFs, which leaves it on the cylinder up to the chord error d^2/2R. Consumed by the Meep matched-geometry work (#1088) and benchmarks/patch_antenna_conformal/scripts/plot_patch_displacement.py.
format: node_ids, is_patch, base and moved are parallel arrays, one entry per dumped node; node_ids holds the 0-based node index in the fixture mesh. patch_triangles, substrate_top_triangles and patch_outline_loop hold 0-based indices into these local arrays, not mesh node ids (map through node_ids).
frame: bent fixture coordinates (x, y, z); bend axis parallel to y through (x = 0, z = z_axis_mm); chart s = R*atan2(x, z - z_axis), y
radial_basis: 1x1 clamped uniform B-splines (degree 0/0) in (s, y) over the patch, times feed cutoff (0 within 0.80 mm, 1 beyond 4.00 mm) and a 12 mm smoothstep margin decay; outward radial motion 0.8 mm per unit
